Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing a refill of a prescription under certain emergent circumstances.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to refilling a prescription; adding a new sectionto chapter 69.41 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 48.43 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 69.41 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Nothing in this chapter prohibits a pharmacy from providing aperson with a refill of a drug prior to any time restriction for theprescription of that drug if: (1) There are authorized refills remaining; (2) The person seeking the refill resides in a county that: (a) Is under a flood warning issued by the national weatherservice; (b) Is declared to be under a state of emergency as proclaimed bythe governor; or (c) Has activated its emergency operations center and its emergencymanagement plan; and (3) The refill is requested within thirty days after theorigination date of the conditions described in subsection (2) of this p. 1 HB 2583section or until those conditions are terminated by the issuingauthority or no longer exist.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Every health carrier that provides prescription medicationcoverage as part of a health plan shall waive time restrictions onprescription medication refills to enable an enrollee to refillprescriptions prior to the time restriction, if there are authorizedrefills remaining, and shall authorize payments to pharmacies for atleast a thirty-day supply of any prescription medication, regardless ofthe date that the prescription had most recently been refilled by apharmacy if the conditions in section 1 of this act have been met. (2) Nothing in subsection (1) of this section excuses or exempts anenrollee from compliance with all other terms of the health plan.
